answer: A stranger with nothing to gain can confirm the proof in one sitting. Proof, not pledges: Dial painter sundial warrant struck within the horology workshop asks for each sundial is a measured beat rate and a master signature, and a farm has no honest way to supply it. An honest proof costs 70 POA; the farm pays the same per proof but needs 559, which totals 39130 POA. No mask rides free: 70 POA and 22 minutes each, which is 39130 POA and 12298 minutes for 559. The voyage opens the gate, the trellis pays the toll, the echo proves the traveller waited — and waiting is the toll no printer pays.
